remarks: Discover the charm of this inviting 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom condo, designed for both comfort and style. The primary bedroom boasts a spacious walk-in closet and a private half bath, creating a serene retreat. Inside, convenience is key with in-unit washer and dryer hookups and central air conditioning to keep you cool during warmer months. Say goodbye to unexpected expenses-your monthly common charges cover heat, hot water, flood insurance, security surveillance, and on-site maintenance. Pet-friendly and thoughtfully designed, this community offers ample parking just steps from your door, along with additional storage space. At Candlelight Terrace, you're not just finding a home-you're embracing a lifestyle. Enjoy sunny afternoons by the in-ground pool, host weekend cookouts with friends, or take peaceful strolls along the scenic Rippowam River, surrounded by lush greenery. With downtown Stamford just minutes away, you'll have easy access to shopping, dining, and entertainment, plus plenty of visitor parking for when friends and family come to visit!
